title: Core compatibility of tensor restriction with canonical open-section comparison
statement: After expanding the transport along hi and the canonical tensor-to-restriction comparison, the tensor restriction map commutes with these component comparisons and the ordinary presheaf restriction.

proof.text: Compare the composition of open-restriction adjunctions with restriction along the composite. Their unit equations agree sectionwise by presheaf functoriality, hence the conjugate of restrictFunctorComp.hom is pushforwardComp.hom. Conjugate the inverses of the canonical leftAdjointUniq comparisons; conjugateEquiv_comp and the whiskering equations identify their composite with the inverse normalized tensorSectionsComp. Invert to obtain compatibility of the forward comparison maps with composition.

Evaluate this composition equation on a top section. Naturality of the tensor adjunction unit moves the comparison past the tensor section unit, and unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app turns this into the ordinary restriction-adjunction unit.

For composable open immersions, eliminate the equality of the composite with its specified target morphism. Expand restrictFunctorComp_inv_app_app, restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app and restrict_map. The resulting ordinary presheaf maps compose to the single inclusion map because opens form a thin category. Specialize to homOfLE and the two open inclusions, and compose with the image-top transports; the remaining square follows again from presheaf map_comp and thinness.

Eliminate the equalities identifying the underlying Over objects with open restrictions. Every morphism between these objects equals restrictFunctor.map of the inclusion: cancel the monomorphism U.ι in their equations over X. Apply the preceding open-inclusion result and then the object equalities obtained from hi.

proof_origin.place: Equation (35.8.0.1); explicit adjunction-uniqueness and restriction-unit proof in Lean by S3, 2026-10-13.
